voicing_rules: Violin1 = melody crown: chord tones (1/3/5) or characteristic extension (9/13); #11 only when in the written quality
When piano/voice carries the melody, Violin1 may double +12 or take the top chord tone / 6 / 9
Violin2 + Viola1 + Viola2 = inner triad choir (1-3-5, 3-5-9, or 3-5-7), not six independent tensions
Inner choir articulations: long legato pad, pizzicato groove, or marcato hits
Cello = counter-melody, unison/−12, or sixth below crown
Contrabass = root as foundation; 3/5/7/9 inversions to approach the next chord
Unison Vln1–Vln2 and octave Cello–Bass are legal and frequent in the corpus

textures.label: Legato pad
textures.behavior: Inner choir sustained; Violin1 phrased; bass slow

textures.label: Pizzicato groove
textures.behavior: Inner three voices short pattern; Violin1 more sustained

textures.label: Marcato hits
textures.behavior: Aligned short attacks for cadences and turnarounds

textures.label: Unison / octave
textures.behavior: Violin1=Violin2; Cello near Bass +12 — climax density

approach_tension_resolution.description: Schéma harmonique central du style Axel Fisch, fluide et modal.
